name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Book Holder With Books Read Tracker
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality natural wood, sturdy and eco-friendly. Main structure crafted from 5mm thick wood for excellent stability. Smoothly cut edges with a natural wood grain finish for a premium look.
    - The product includes wooden number cards designed to fit perfectly within the hanging bar system:
    →  Number Cards: Made from durable wooden material, 3mm thickness.
    →  Hanging Bar: wooden hanging bar, 5mm thickness.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size (W x H): 8 x 8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    - Designed to stand firmly on bookshelves, desks, or tabletops without tipping.
    - Compact yet eye-catching, suitable for both small and large book collections.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - The product is printed on both sides, allowing designs to be clearly visible from the front and back without color fading.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Functions as a book holder to keep books neatly upright on shelves or desks.
    - Includes wooden number cards to track the number of books read (Books Read Tracker).
    - Numbers are easy to change and reposition, making it interactive and practical.
    - Perfect for organizing books while adding a decorative and motivational element to your reading space.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and unique gift for book lovers, readers, students, teachers, and librarians.
    - Suitable for all occasions such as birthdays, Christmas, anniversaries, housewarmings, back-to-school, or reading challenges.
    - Ideal for home libraries, offices, classrooms, or cozy reading corners.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Book Holder With Books Read Tracker

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
